appearances.activity: Kim Jong Un attended a garment and shoe light industry expo in Pyongyang with his daughter, touring exhibits and touting regional policy achievements, per KCNA state media reported October 20.

Kim Jong Un made an unannounced visit to Dandong, China, crossing the newly opened New Yalu River Bridge on October 24, and chaired the Third Meeting of Company Leaders of the Korean People's Army in Pyongyang on October 22-23.
Kim Jong Un returned to Pyongyang from Dandong, China, after crossing the New Yalu River Bridge on October 24 — confirmed by KCNA state media reported October 25.

Kim Jong Un attended the 'Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Development-2026' exhibition, observing live-fire demonstrations of suicide attack drones, cruise missiles, and the 600mm 'Sniper' multiple rocket launcher, and called for 'absolute superiority' in drone technology.
Kim Jong Un inspected the new warship under construction at Nampho Shipyard and ordered strengthening of surface and underwater naval capabilities alongside modernization of the facility.
Kim Jong Un inspected a new warship under construction at Nampho Shipyard on Nov. 7 and ordered strengthening of surface and underwater naval capabilities alongside modernization of the facility.
Kim Jong Un inspected the construction site of a major naval base on North Korea's east coast, ordering that it be completed on the schedule and to the quality standard set by the party central.
Kim Jong Un inspected a second major east-coast naval base under construction on November 12, ordering that it be completed on the schedule and to the quality standard set by the party central.
Kim Jong Un inspected a second major east-coast naval base under construction on November 12-13, ordering that it be completed on the schedule and to the quality standard set by the party central.
